On the device that will send photos, open MediaSync and scan this code. A computer without a camera: copy the link below and paste it there.
The code and the link work once, for 5 minutes. Both devices need to be on the same network.

On the receiving device, open MediaSync, choose Add sending device, then Copy link (on a phone: Share pairing link, and send it to this computer). Then paste the link here.
Paste the receiver's link
The clipboard holds no MediaSync pairing link. Copy it on the receiving device first.
